title: See how code reaches users
statement: As an architect, I can draw how code gets from a developer's machine out into the world, linked to the code that does it, so anyone can see the real process and tell when the drawing has fallen behind.
overview: This is an ordinary named whiteboard in a new navigation role, not a new document type. Whiteboards already pin code and go stale.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Release Process Overview entry opens the whiteboard assigned to that role, with the same reader as any other whiteboard.
An element can pin the exact lines of a workflow, script or infrastructure file and open them in the code drawer.
When a pinned file changes, the element shows as stale in the reader, and `status` and `check --covers health` report it like any other whiteboard evidence.
A Saga with no such board shows how to publish one and reports no health failure.
